Command: Go Down to Egypt Without Fear
Summary: God's command to Jacob at Beersheba: fear not to go down into Egypt, for God would make him a great nation there and bring him up again.
Commandment: Fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation.
Application: Jacob was already on the road to Joseph when God spoke; the command removed the fear of leaving the promised land by promising both presence in Egypt and return. No story title matches Jacob's descent itself (Joseph and His Brothers is Joseph's story), so RelatedEvents is left empty.
Purpose: To authorize Jacob's descent to Joseph in Egypt with the promise of nationhood there and eventual return (Genesis 46:3-4).
